name: Causing Your Brother To Stumble
overview: Scripture sternly warns against causing a fellow believer to stumble, emphasizing the gravity of leading others, especially the weak in faith, into sin or doubt. Believers are called to exercise their liberty responsibly, serving one another in love rather than indulging the flesh, which manifests in sinful works. The danger of spiritual deception through worldly philosophies is also highlighted, urging vigilance to remain grounded in Christ. Together, these passages underscore the serious responsibility Christians bear to protect and nurture the faith of their brothers and sisters.
